contexts.text: This takes place with a painful pulling asunder.
Some (are punished) by pullings asunder and various collisions. AC 957:2. SE 865. SE 958:end. SE 1696:end. SE 2746.
The sphere of a number of such together is so distractive, that there is nothing there but what is hostile...
Like those who are called distracted...
This conjunction can only be loosened... by a pulling asunder, which carries away all spiritual life with it.
Their thoughts cannot so flow into human minds as to distract, still less confound them... Moreover, the thoughts of the Angels are concordant and unanimous, thus not at all distracting.
They have not their thought determined to anything fixed, thus they are ever distracted, as it were not in the body.
A people scattered and peeled () = those with whom truths have been taken away, changed, or perverted by those who are in falsities of doctrine.
